description: This Java class defines a REST controller for handling payment authorization endpoints, specifically for PayPal payments. It includes an endpoint to authorize a payment, utilizing dependency injection of an authorization flow service, and uses Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: PaymentController
classes.description: A REST controller providing payment authorization endpoints. It handles HTTP POST requests to authorize PayPal payments and returns authorization responses.

methods.name: authorizePayPal
methods.description: Handles POST requests to authorize a PayPal payment, creating an authorization attempt and invoking the authorization flow service, then returning the response with authorization details.
